main_text.l: nione fuspendit[?].habuitq; ille hanc vere-cundiam, ut tanti viri judicio notatus, sponte concederet. Ceterum antea inno-cens, postea depravatus, videri poterat jam tum nocens fuisse, cum de eo fuerat judicatum. Nacti ergo Arriani istiusmodi occasionem, conspirant penitus, Sardi-censis synodi decreta subvertere. Etenim eis color quidam suppetere videbatur, quod tam iniuste fuisset pro Athanasio judicatum, quam Marcellus fuerat absolutus, qui nunc etiam Athanasii judicio haereticus esse probaretur. Namque Marcellus Sabellianæ haeresis assertor exstitit, Photinus vero novam haeresim jam ante protulerat, a Sabellio quidem in unione dissentiens, sed initium Christi ex Maria praedicabat. Igitur Arriani astuto consilio miscent innoxium criminosis, damnationemque Photini & Marcelli & Athanasii eadem sententia comprehenduntur: illud nimirum apud Imperatorum animos praestruentes, ut non putarentur de Athanasio perperam judicasse, qui de Marcello atque Photino vera sensissent. Verumtamen ea tempestate Arriani perfidiam suam occultabant, non aufi palam erroris sui

page.notes: Printed page number "149" read from a worn top-right corner, so uncertain. Word "fuspendit" in the first line is hard to read and may be wrong; the line opens as a fragment. Several marginal notes are small and worn: "error. Epiph. lib." and "Confpira. tio Arri. norum in Athana- sium." are best readings. "Photini" is the note beside "Marcellus". The margin note "tom. 1." is read from the abbreviation and may be "tom. 1." or similar. The final line ends without a catchword. Long s is written as plain s throughout.
